summary.text: Son of Caeneus from Magnesia, Argonaut in Hyginus' roll.

story.text: Hyginus lists Priasus son of Caeneus among Jason's comrades from Magnesia.
Like his brother Phocus, Priasus is tagged only with the region Magnesia in Hyginus — no source in our corpus names a specific polis for either son of Caeneus.
